```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
codepath <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
project_root <- dirname(dirname(codepath))
datapath <- file.path(project_root, "data")
vispath <- file.path(project_root, "vis")
modelpath <- file.path(datapath, "models")

outpath <- file.path(datapath, "results_markdown", "part2_stopping")
figpath <- file.path(vispath, "results", "part2_stopping")
dir.create(outpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(codepath, "data_loading_functions.R"))

settings <- list(
  methods_keep = c("ICA", "CCA"),
  sesoi_prop = params$sesoi_prop,
  use_bounded_sesoi = params$use_bounded_sesoi,
  sesoi_floor = params$sesoi_floor,
  sesoi_cap = params$sesoi_cap,
  model_useful_p_decrease_by_sesoi_min = 0.80,
  model_plateau_p_decrease_by_sesoi_max = 0.20,
  model_plateau_p_same_min = 0.80,
  model_harm_p_increase_by_sesoi_min = 0.80,
  model_sesoi_definition = params$model_sesoi_definition,
  model_rpeak_file = file.path(modelpath, "main_all_channels.rds")
)

safe_q <- function(x, p) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}

mode_int <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  as.integer(names(tab)[1])
}

first_true_value <- function(value, flag, default = NA_integer_) {
  ok <- which(flag %in% TRUE)
  if (length(ok) == 0) return(default)
  value[min(ok)]
}

last_true_value <- function(value, flag, default = NA_integer_) {
  ok <- which(flag %in% TRUE)
  if (length(ok) == 0) return(default)
  value[max(ok)]
}

parse_consec_contrast <- function(x) {
  nums <- stringr::str_extract_all(as.character(x), "\\d+")
  purrr::map_dfr(nums, function(z) {
    z <- as.integer(z)
    if (length(z) >= 2) {
      tibble(clean_to = z[1], clean_from = z[2])
    } else {
      tibble(clean_to = NA_integer_, clean_from = NA_integer_)
    }
  })
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
}

save_table <- function(x, name, csv = TRUE) {
  rds_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(x, rds_file)
  csv_file <- NA_character_
  if (csv) {
    csv_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".csv"))
    utils::write.csv(x, csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  tibble(
    name = name,
    rds = rds_file,
    csv = csv_file,
    n_rows = ifelse(is.data.frame(x), nrow(x), NA_integer_)
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 4.5) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$save_figures)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".png")), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}
```

# Analysis logic

Part 1 established the method-level ICA versus CCA comparison. Part 2 asks a different question: **how many components should be removed before additional cleaning stops producing meaningful R-peak reduction?**

Definitions used throughout:

1. `clean == 1` is the no-cleaning baseline and is displayed as **0 components removed**.
2. `clean == 2` means **1 component removed**, `clean == 3` means **2 components removed**, and so on.
3. A consecutive step is **useful** if R-peak prominence decreases by more than the participant × EEG-channel SESOI.
4. A consecutive step is a **plateau** if the change is within SESOI.
5. A consecutive step is **harmful** if R-peak prominence increases by more than SESOI.

Three stopping-related quantities are reported separately:

1. **First non-useful**: conservative/early stopping. Stop before the first transition that does not produce a SESOI-meaningful R-peak decrease.
2. **Last meaningful**: liberal/late stopping. Keep cleaning until the last transition that still produces a SESOI-meaningful R-peak decrease.
3. **All meaningful candidates**: diagnostic count of how many component-removal steps produced a SESOI-meaningful improvement, aggregated across all transitions even if plateaus occurred before or between them.

# Load full 15-channel R-peak data

```{r load-rpeak-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load_full15_rpeak_all_methods <- function() {
  chlabels_data1 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels.mat")
  chlabels_data2 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels_data2.mat")
  n_data1 <- length(chlabels_data1)
  n_data2 <- length(chlabels_data2)
  participant_levels <- sprintf("P%02d", seq_len(n_data1 + n_data2))
  
  df_data1 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset = "data1",
    offset = 0,
    methods = settings$methods_keep,
    measure = "rpeak",
    value_name = "rpeak"
  )
  
  df_data2 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats_2.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset = "data2",
    offset = n_data1,
    methods = settings$methods_keep,
    measure = "rpeak",
    value_name = "rpeak"
  )
  
  bind_rows(df_data1, df_data2) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = as.character(dataset),
      participant = as.character(participant),
      subID = factor(subID, levels = participant_levels),
      method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")),
      clean = as.integer(clean),
      components_removed = clean - 1L,
      cleaning_level = factor(clean, levels = sort(unique(clean))),
      components_removed_factor = factor(components_removed, levels = sort(unique(components_removed))),
      channel = as.character(channel)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(rpeak))
}

full15_rpeak <- load_full15_rpeak_all_methods()

manifest[["01_full15_rpeak_light"]] <- save_table(
  full15_rpeak %>%
    select(dataset, participant, method, channel, components_removed, rpeak),
  "01_full15_rpeak_light",
  csv = FALSE
)
```

# SESOI definition

```{r sesoi-definition}
sesoi_raw <- full15_rpeak %>%
  filter(components_removed == 0) %>%
  group_by(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    initial_subj = mean(rpeak, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_baseline_values = n(),
    n_methods_at_baseline = n_distinct(method),
    sesoi_raw = settings$sesoi_prop * abs(initial_subj),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(initial_subj), is.finite(sesoi_raw), sesoi_raw > 0)

sesoi_subj_channel <- sesoi_raw %>%
  mutate(
    sesoi = if (isTRUE(settings$use_bounded_sesoi)) {
      pmin(pmax(sesoi_raw, settings$sesoi_floor), settings$sesoi_cap)
    } else {
      sesoi_raw
    },
    sesoi_was_floored = sesoi > sesoi_raw,
    sesoi_was_capped = sesoi < sesoi_raw,
    sesoi_definition = if_else(
      isTRUE(settings$use_bounded_sesoi),
      "bounded_5pct_subject_channel",
      "raw_5pct_subject_channel"
    )
  )

sesoi_distribution <- sesoi_subj_channel %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    median_initial_rpeak = median(initial_subj, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_initial_rpeak = safe_q(initial_subj, 0.25),
    q75_initial_rpeak = safe_q(initial_subj, 0.75),
    min_sesoi = min(sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    q05_sesoi = safe_q(sesoi, 0.05),
    median_sesoi = median(sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95_sesoi = safe_q(sesoi, 0.95),
    max_sesoi = max(sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_floored = sum(sesoi_was_floored, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_capped = sum(sesoi_was_capped, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

manifest[["03_sesoi_subj_channel"]] <- save_table(
  sesoi_subj_channel,
  "03_sesoi_subj_channel"
)
manifest[["03_sesoi_distribution"]] <- save_table(
  sesoi_distribution,
  "03_sesoi_distribution"
)

kable(sesoi_distribution, digits = 3)
```

# Observed consecutive R-peak changes

```{r observed-consecutive-changes}
clean_obs_consec <- full15_rpeak %>%
  select(dataset, participant, subID, method, channel, clean, components_removed, cleaning_level, rpeak) %>%
  group_by(dataset, participant, method, channel, clean, components_removed) %>%
  summarise(
    rpeak = mean(rpeak, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sesoi_subj_channel %>%
      select(dataset, participant, channel, initial_subj, sesoi, sesoi_raw, sesoi_definition),
    by = c("dataset", "participant", "channel")
  ) %>%
  group_by(dataset, participant, method, channel) %>%
  arrange(components_removed, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    clean_from = clean,
    clean_to = lead(clean),
    components_removed_from = components_removed,
    components_removed_to = lead(components_removed),
    component_removed = components_removed_to,
    rpeak_from = rpeak,
    rpeak_to = lead(rpeak),
    diff_next_minus_current = rpeak_to - rpeak_from,
    abs_diff_next_minus_current = abs(diff_next_minus_current),
    contrast_components = paste0(components_removed_to, " - ", components_removed_from),
    decrease = diff_next_minus_current < 0,
    decrease_by_SESOI = diff_next_minus_current < -sesoi,
    increase_by_SESOI = diff_next_minus_current > sesoi,
    practically_same = abs(diff_next_minus_current) <= sesoi,
    transition_class = case_when(
      decrease_by_SESOI ~ "decrease > SESOI",
      increase_by_SESOI ~ "increase > SESOI",
      TRUE ~ "within SESOI"
    ),
    transition_class = factor(
      transition_class,
      levels = c("decrease > SESOI", "within SESOI", "increase > SESOI")
    ),
    diff_sesoi_units = diff_next_minus_current / sesoi,
    percent_change_from_initial = 100 * diff_next_minus_current / abs(initial_subj),
    percent_change_from_current = 100 * diff_next_minus_current / abs(rpeak_from)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(component_removed)) %>%
  ungroup()

obs_transition_summary <- clean_obs_consec %>%
  group_by(method, components_removed_from, components_removed_to, component_removed, contrast_components) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    pct_decrease = 100 * mean(decrease, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_decrease_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(decrease_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_practically_same = 100 * mean(practically_same, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_increase_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(increase_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_diff = median(diff_next_minus_current, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_diff = safe_q(diff_next_minus_current, 0.25),
    q75_diff = safe_q(diff_next_minus_current, 0.75),
    median_diff_sesoi_units = median(diff_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.25),
    q75_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.75),
    median_percent_change_from_initial = median(percent_change_from_initial, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_percent_change_from_current = median(percent_change_from_current, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, component_removed)

obs_transition_summary_display <- obs_transition_summary %>%
  select(
    method,
    component_removed,
    n_participant_channel_cells,
    pct_decrease_by_SESOI,
    pct_practically_same,
    pct_increase_by_SESOI,
    median_diff_sesoi_units,
    q25_diff_sesoi_units,
    q75_diff_sesoi_units
  )

manifest[["04_clean_obs_consec"]] <- save_table(
  clean_obs_consec %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      participant,
      method,
      channel,
      components_removed_from,
      components_removed_to,
      component_removed,
      rpeak_from,
      rpeak_to,
      diff_next_minus_current,
      sesoi,
      diff_sesoi_units,
      decrease_by_SESOI,
      practically_same,
      increase_by_SESOI,
      transition_class
    ),
  "04_clean_obs_consec",
  csv = FALSE
)
manifest[["04_obs_transition_summary"]] <- save_table(
  obs_transition_summary,
  "04_obs_transition_summary"
)
manifest[["04_obs_transition_summary_display"]] <- save_table(
  obs_transition_summary_display,
  "04_obs_transition_summary_display"
)

kable(obs_transition_summary_display, digits = 2)
```

```{r observed-transition-plot}
transition_plot_data <- obs_transition_summary %>%
  select(
    method,
    component_removed,
    pct_decrease_by_SESOI,
    pct_practically_same,
    pct_increase_by_SESOI
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "transition_type",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transition_type = recode(
      transition_type,
      pct_decrease_by_SESOI = "decrease > SESOI",
      pct_practically_same = "within SESOI",
      pct_increase_by_SESOI = "increase > SESOI"
    ),
    transition_type = factor(
      transition_type,
      levels = c("decrease > SESOI", "within SESOI", "increase > SESOI")
    )
  )

p_transition_classes <- ggplot(
  transition_plot_data,
  aes(x = component_removed, y = percent, fill = transition_type)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transition_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(transition_plot_data$component_removed))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = "Component removed",
    y = "% participant × EEG-channel observations",
    fill = "Consecutive change",
    title = "Observed consecutive R-peak changes",
    subtitle = "Each bar classifies the change produced by removing one additional component"
  ) +
  theme_pub

p_transition_classes
save_plot_both(
  p_transition_classes,
  "01_observed_transition_classes",
  width = 8,
  height = 4.2
)
```

# Participant × EEG-channel stopping definitions

```{r participant-channel-stopping}
stopping_points_subj <- clean_obs_consec %>%
  group_by(dataset, participant, method, channel) %>%
  arrange(components_removed_from, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    initial_subj = first(initial_subj),
    sesoi = first(sesoi),
    sesoi_raw = first(sesoi_raw),
    sesoi_definition = first(sesoi_definition),
    n_transitions = n(),
    n_useful_improvements = sum(decrease_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plateau_steps = sum(practically_same, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_harmful_steps = sum(increase_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_nonuseful_components = first_true_value(
      components_removed_from,
      !decrease_by_SESOI,
      max(components_removed_to, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    last_meaningful_component = last_true_value(
      component_removed,
      decrease_by_SESOI,
      0L
    ),
    first_plateau_component = first_true_value(
      component_removed,
      practically_same,
      NA_integer_
    ),
    first_harm_component = first_true_value(
      component_removed,
      increase_by_SESOI,
      NA_integer_
    ),
    median_step_diff_sesoi_units = median(diff_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_step_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.25),
    q75_step_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    retained_components_first_nonuseful = first_nonuseful_components,
    retained_components_after_last_meaningful = last_meaningful_component
  )

all_meaningful_candidates <- clean_obs_consec %>%
  filter(decrease_by_SESOI) %>%
  group_by(dataset, participant, method, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_all_meaningful_candidates = n(),
    meaningful_candidate_components = paste(sort(unique(component_removed)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopping_points_subj_report <- stopping_points_subj %>%
  left_join(
    all_meaningful_candidates,
    by = c("dataset", "participant", "method", "channel")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_all_meaningful_candidates = replace_na(n_all_meaningful_candidates, 0L),
    meaningful_candidate_components = replace_na(meaningful_candidate_components, "")
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant,
    method,
    channel,
    initial_subj,
    sesoi,
    n_useful_improvements,
    n_all_meaningful_candidates,
    meaningful_candidate_components,
    n_plateau_steps,
    n_harmful_steps,
    retained_components_first_nonuseful,
    retained_components_after_last_meaningful,
    first_plateau_component,
    first_harm_component
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, participant, channel)

manifest[["05_stopping_points_subj"]] <- save_table(
  stopping_points_subj,
  "05_stopping_points_subj",
  csv = FALSE
)
manifest[["05_all_meaningful_candidates"]] <- save_table(
  all_meaningful_candidates,
  "05_all_meaningful_candidates"
)
manifest[["05_stopping_points_subj_report"]] <- save_table(
  stopping_points_subj_report,
  "05_stopping_points_subj_report"
)

kable(head(stopping_points_subj_report, 20), digits = 2)
```

## Compact stopping summaries

```{r stopping-summaries}
stopping_points_subj_summary <- stopping_points_subj %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    median_retained_components_first_nonuseful = median(retained_components_first_nonuseful, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_retained_components_first_nonuseful = mode_int(retained_components_first_nonuseful),
    q25_retained_components_first_nonuseful = safe_q(retained_components_first_nonuseful, 0.25),
    q75_retained_components_first_nonuseful = safe_q(retained_components_first_nonuseful, 0.75),
    median_retained_components_after_last_meaningful = median(retained_components_after_last_meaningful, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_retained_components_after_last_meaningful = mode_int(retained_components_after_last_meaningful),
    q25_retained_components_after_last_meaningful = safe_q(retained_components_after_last_meaningful, 0.25),
    q75_retained_components_after_last_meaningful = safe_q(retained_components_after_last_meaningful, 0.75),
    pct_stop_at_0_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(retained_components_after_last_meaningful == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_stop_2_to_4_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(retained_components_after_last_meaningful %in% 2:4, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_stop_3_to_5_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(retained_components_after_last_meaningful %in% 3:5, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_stop_4_to_6_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(retained_components_after_last_meaningful %in% 4:6, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_stop_10_or_more_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(retained_components_after_last_meaningful >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_stop_at_max_after_last_meaningful = 100 * mean(
      retained_components_after_last_meaningful == max(retained_components_after_last_meaningful, na.rm = TRUE),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_n_useful_improvements = median(n_useful_improvements, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n_plateau_steps = median(n_plateau_steps, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n_harmful_steps = median(n_harmful_steps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

manifest[["06_stopping_points_subj_summary"]] <- save_table(
  stopping_points_subj_summary,
  "06_stopping_points_subj_summary"
)
```

```{r stopping-rule-plots}
make_stopping_hist <- function(data, rule_keep, title = NULL, x_label = "Number of components") {
  plot_data <- data %>% filter(stopping_rule == rule_keep)
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(n_components), fill = method)) +
    geom_bar(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_cols) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Across participant × EEG-channel observations",
      x = x_label,
      y = "Participant × EEG-channel count",
      fill = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

make_stopping_cumulative <- function(data, rule_keep, title = NULL, x_label = "Number of components") {
  plot_data <- data %>% filter(stopping_rule == rule_keep)
  max_components <- max(plot_data$n_components, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cumulative_data <- plot_data %>%
    tidyr::crossing(component = 0:max_components) %>%
    mutate(retained_or_counted = n_components >= component) %>%
    group_by(method, component) %>%
    summarise(
      pct_participant_channels = 100 * mean(retained_or_counted, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ggplot(cumulative_data, aes(x = component, y = pct_participant_channels, colour = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:max_components) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Across participant × EEG-channel observations",
      x = x_label,
      y = "% participant × EEG-channel observations",
      colour = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_pub
}
```

# All SESOI-meaningful component candidates by component index

The previous plots summarise stopping rules or the **number** of meaningful candidate steps per participant × EEG-channel observation. The plots below ask a more direct question: **which exact component removals produced SESOI-meaningful R-peak improvements**, irrespective of whether earlier plateaus had already occurred.

```{r all-meaningful-candidate-events}
all_meaningful_candidate_events <- clean_obs_consec %>%
  filter(decrease_by_SESOI) %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = as.character(dataset),
    participant = as.character(participant),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")),
    channel = as.character(channel),
    component_removed = as.integer(component_removed)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    dataset,
    participant,
    method,
    channel,
    component_removed
  )

all_meaningful_candidate_pct <- clean_obs_consec %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")),
    component_removed = as.integer(component_removed)
  ) %>%
  group_by(method, component_removed) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channels = n(),
    n_meaningful = sum(decrease_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_meaningful = 100 * mean(decrease_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, component_removed)

all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts <- all_meaningful_candidate_events %>%
  count(method, component_removed, name = "n_meaningful_participant_channels") %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_of_all_meaningful_events =
      100 * n_meaningful_participant_channels / sum(n_meaningful_participant_channels),
    cumulative_pct_of_all_meaningful_events =
      cumsum(pct_of_all_meaningful_events)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

manifest[["08_all_meaningful_candidate_events"]] <- save_table(
  all_meaningful_candidate_events,
  "08_all_meaningful_candidate_events"
)
manifest[["08_all_meaningful_candidate_pct_by_component"]] <- save_table(
  all_meaningful_candidate_pct,
  "08_all_meaningful_candidate_pct_by_component"
)
manifest[["08_all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts"]] <- save_table(
  all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts,
  "08_all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts"
)
```

# Model-based consecutive contrasts and plateaus

The saved all-channel model uses `cleaning_level` internally as a categorical factor. The public tables below convert this to the number of removed components, so model transitions are displayed as components 1–15.

```{r model-based-stopping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
model_sesoi_lookup <- sesoi_subj_channel %>%
  summarise(
    sesoi_model_median_subject_channel = median(sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    sesoi_model_mean_subject_channel = mean(sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    sesoi_model_q25_subject_channel = safe_q(sesoi, 0.25),
    sesoi_model_q75_subject_channel = safe_q(sesoi, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sesoi_model = case_when(
      settings$model_sesoi_definition == "mean_subject_channel" ~ sesoi_model_mean_subject_channel,
      TRUE ~ sesoi_model_median_subject_channel
    ),
    sesoi_model_definition = settings$model_sesoi_definition
  )

model_clean_draws <- tibble()
model_clean_summary <- tibble()
model_stopping_points <- tibble()

if (isTRUE(params$run_model_summaries)) {
  if (!file.exists(settings$model_rpeak_file)) {
    stop("Cannot find model file: ", basename(settings$model_rpeak_file))
  }
  
  fit_main <- readRDS(settings$model_rpeak_file)
  
  emm_clean <- emmeans::emmeans(
    fit_main,
    ~ cleaning_level | method,
    epred = TRUE,
    re_formula = NA
  )
  
  clean_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(
    emm_clean,
    method = "consec"
  )
  
  model_clean_draws_raw <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(clean_contrasts) %>%
    mutate(
      method = as.character(method),
      contrast = as.character(contrast)
    )
  
  contrast_parsed <- parse_consec_contrast(model_clean_draws_raw$contrast)
  
  model_clean_draws <- bind_cols(model_clean_draws_raw, contrast_parsed) %>%
    mutate(
      components_removed_from = clean_from - 1L,
      components_removed_to = clean_to - 1L,
      component_removed = components_removed_to,
      contrast_components = paste0(components_removed_to, " - ", components_removed_from),
      sesoi_model = model_sesoi_lookup$sesoi_model[[1]],
      sesoi_model_definition = model_sesoi_lookup$sesoi_model_definition[[1]],
      diff_sesoi_units = .value / sesoi_model,
      decrease = .value < 0,
      decrease_by_SESOI = .value < -sesoi_model,
      increase_by_SESOI = .value > sesoi_model,
      practically_same = abs(.value) <= sesoi_model
    )
  
  model_clean_summary <- model_clean_draws %>%
    group_by(method, components_removed_from, components_removed_to, component_removed, contrast_components) %>%
    summarise(
      sesoi_model = first(sesoi_model),
      sesoi_model_definition = first(sesoi_model_definition),
      median_diff = median(.value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower95_diff = safe_q(.value, 0.025),
      upper95_diff = safe_q(.value, 0.975),
      median_diff_sesoi_units = median(diff_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower95_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.025),
      upper95_diff_sesoi_units = safe_q(diff_sesoi_units, 0.975),
      p_decrease = mean(decrease, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_decrease_by_SESOI = mean(decrease_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_practically_same = mean(practically_same, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_increase_by_SESOI = mean(increase_by_SESOI, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      useful_improvement_model =
        p_decrease_by_SESOI >= settings$model_useful_p_decrease_by_sesoi_min,
      likely_plateau_model =
        p_decrease_by_SESOI <= settings$model_plateau_p_decrease_by_sesoi_max &
        p_practically_same >= settings$model_plateau_p_same_min,
      possible_harm_model =
        p_increase_by_SESOI >= settings$model_harm_p_increase_by_sesoi_min
    ) %>%
    arrange(method, component_removed)
  
  model_stopping_points <- model_clean_summary %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    arrange(components_removed_from, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(
      n_transitions = n(),
      n_useful_model_transitions = sum(useful_improvement_model, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_likely_plateau_model_transitions = sum(likely_plateau_model, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_possible_harm_model_transitions = sum(possible_harm_model, na.rm = TRUE),
      retained_components_model_after_last_useful = last_true_value(
        component_removed,
        useful_improvement_model,
        0L
      ),
      retained_components_model_first_nonuseful = first_true_value(
        components_removed_from,
        !useful_improvement_model,
        max(components_removed_to, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      first_likely_plateau_component_model = first_true_value(
        component_removed,
        likely_plateau_model,
        NA_integer_
      ),
      first_possible_harm_component_model = first_true_value(
        component_removed,
        possible_harm_model,
        NA_integer_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

manifest[["09_model_sesoi_lookup"]] <- save_table(
  model_sesoi_lookup,
  "09_model_sesoi_lookup"
)

if (nrow(model_clean_summary) > 0) {
  manifest[["09_model_clean_summary"]] <- save_table(
    model_clean_summary,
    "09_model_clean_summary"
  )
  manifest[["09_model_stopping_points"]] <- save_table(
    model_stopping_points,
    "09_model_stopping_points"
  )
}

kable(model_sesoi_lookup, digits = 3)
if (nrow(model_clean_summary) > 0) kable(model_clean_summary, digits = 3)
if (nrow(model_stopping_points) > 0) kable(model_stopping_points, digits = 2)
```

```{r model-plots, eval=TRUE}
if (nrow(model_clean_summary) > 0) {
  p_model_diff <- ggplot(
    model_clean_summary,
    aes(x = component_removed, y = median_diff_sesoi_units, colour = method)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = cca_pal$zero) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = "dotted", colour = cca_pal$mid_grey) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower95_diff_sesoi_units, ymax = upper95_diff_sesoi_units), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(model_clean_summary$component_removed))) +
    labs(
      x = "Component removed",
      y = "Consecutive model contrast in SESOI units",
      colour = "Method",
      title = "Model-estimated consecutive R-peak changes",
      subtitle = "Negative values indicate R-peak reduction; dotted line marks one SESOI decrease"
    ) +
    theme_pub
  
  p_model_probs <- model_clean_summary %>%
    select(method, component_removed, p_decrease_by_SESOI, p_practically_same, p_increase_by_SESOI) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("p_"),
      names_to = "probability_type",
      values_to = "probability"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      probability_type = recode(
        probability_type,
        p_decrease_by_SESOI = "P(decrease > SESOI)",
        p_practically_same = "P(within SESOI)",
        p_increase_by_SESOI = "P(increase > SESOI)"
      ),
      probability_type = factor(
        probability_type,
        levels = c("P(decrease > SESOI)", "P(within SESOI)", "P(increase > SESOI)")
      )
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = component_removed, y = probability, colour = probability_type)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", colour = cca_pal$mid_grey) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = probability_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(model_clean_summary$component_removed))) +
    labs(
      x = "Component removed",
      y = "Posterior probability",
      colour = "Model probability",
      title = "Model evidence for useful improvement, plateau, and harm",
      subtitle = "Dashed line marks the 0.80 decision threshold"
    ) +
    theme_pub
  
  print(p_model_diff)
  print(p_model_probs)
  save_plot_both(p_model_diff, "11_model_consecutive_differences", width = 7, height = 4.2)
  save_plot_both(p_model_probs, "12_model_probabilities", width = 8, height = 4.2)
}
```

```{r text-ready-stubs}
observed_transition_stubs <- obs_transition_summary %>%

  summarise(
    component_with_max_pct_meaningful = component_removed[which.max(pct_meaningful)][1],
    max_pct_meaningful = max(pct_meaningful, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_component_1 = pct_meaningful[component_removed == 1][1],
    pct_component_2 = pct_meaningful[component_removed == 2][1],
    pct_component_3 = pct_meaningful[component_removed == 3][1],
    pct_component_4 = pct_meaningful[component_removed == 4][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    topic = "all_meaningful_candidates_by_component",
    method,
    sentence_stub = sprintf(
      "%s: SESOI-meaningful candidate events occurred in %.1f%%, %.1f%%, %.1f%%, and %.1f%% of observations for components 1–4, respectively; the maximum was %.1f%% at component %d.",
      method,
      pct_component_1,
      pct_component_2,
      pct_component_3,
      pct_component_4,
      max_pct_meaningful,
      component_with_max_pct_meaningful
    )
  )

model_stubs <- if (nrow(model_stopping_points) > 0) {
  model_stopping_points %>%
    transmute(
      topic = "model_based_stopping",
      method,
      stopping_rule = NA_character_,
      sentence_stub = sprintf(
        "%s model-based stopping: %d transitions met the useful-improvement rule; first non-useful retained components = %d, after-last-useful retained components = %d, and first likely plateau component = %s.",
        method,
        n_useful_model_transitions,
        retained_components_model_first_nonuseful,
        retained_components_model_after_last_useful,
        ifelse(is.na(first_likely_plateau_component_model), "NA", as.character(first_likely_plateau_component_model))
      )
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    topic = "model_based_stopping",
    method = NA_character_,
    stopping_rule = NA_character_,
    sentence_stub = "Model summaries were not run."
  )
}

manuscript_stubs <- bind_rows(
  observed_transition_stubs %>% mutate(stopping_rule = NA_character_),
  stopping_rule_stubs,
  component_candidate_stubs %>% mutate(stopping_rule = NA_character_),
  model_stubs
) %>%
  select(topic, method, stopping_rule, sentence_stub)

manifest[["10_manuscript_sentence_stubs"]] <- save_table(
  manuscript_stubs,
  "10_manuscript_sentence_stubs"
)

kable(manuscript_stubs)
```

# Save compact analysis bundle and manifest

```{r save-bundle-and-manifest, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
settings_public <- settings
settings_public$model_rpeak_file <- basename(settings_public$model_rpeak_file)

stopping_analysis_bundle <- list(
  settings = settings_public,
  sample_accounting = sample_accounting,
  sesoi_distribution = sesoi_distribution,
  obs_transition_summary = obs_transition_summary,
  obs_transition_summary_display = obs_transition_summary_display,
  stopping_points_subj_summary = stopping_points_subj_summary,
  stopping_rule_summary = stopping_rule_summary,
  stopping_rule_counts = stopping_rule_counts,
  all_meaningful_candidate_pct = all_meaningful_candidate_pct,
  all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts = all_meaningful_candidate_event_counts,
  model_sesoi_lookup = model_sesoi_lookup,
  model_clean_summary = model_clean_summary,
  model_stopping_points = model_stopping_points,
  manuscript_stubs = manuscript_stubs
)

saveRDS(stopping_analysis_bundle, file.path(outpath, "11_stopping_analysis_bundle.rds"))
manifest[["11_stopping_analysis_bundle"]] <- tibble(
  name = "11_stopping_analysis_bundle",
  rds = file.path(outpath, "11_stopping_analysis_bundle.rds"),
  csv = NA_character_,
  n_rows = NA_integer_
)

manifest_df <- bind_rows(manifest) %>%
  arrange(name) %>%
  mutate(created_at = Sys.time())

manifest_public <- manifest_df %>%
  mutate(
    rds = if_else(is.na(rds), NA_character_, basename(rds)),
    csv = if_else(is.na(csv), NA_character_, basename(csv))
  )

utils::write.csv(manifest_public, file.path(outpath, "99_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(manifest_public, file.path(outpath, "99_manifest.rds"))

cat("Manifest saved as 99_manifest.rds and 99_manifest.csv.\n")

if (isTRUE(params$show_manifest)) {
  kable(manifest_public)
}
```
